title: NBA: Jazz's Jackson out six weeks with knee injury, Markkanen day to day
summary: Utah Jazz forward Jaren Jackson Jr. will be sidelined at least six weeks with a right knee injury while Finnish star Lauri Markkanen has a sprained wrist, the NBA club said Tuesday.
